current.text: Toronto traded Brandon Ingram away and added Kawhi Leonard.
With Kawhi on the team, Quickley loses usage and should take fewer shots, but he should still have the ball a lot. Without Kawhi he would be a tier higher.
He is a projected starter and part of the expected closing five, next to Barrett, Kawhi and Barnes.
Sean expects the highest-volume three-point season of his career, mostly playing off the ball.
His pull-up and transition three-point shooting were poor last season.
That pull-up and transition shooting needs to return to his career averages.
When Kawhi misses time, he should run more on-ball pick and roll.
He stayed healthier last season than in previous years.
Tier 7 point guard in both formats: solid, with limited upside.
In a points league sleepers video, his ESPN ADP of 114 is called bench range in a standard ESPN league. He was 58th per game last season.
In an early mock draft, Josh regretted taking him with a rushed pick and said Kevin Porter Jr. was the right choice.
The Raptors have 15 back-to-backs this season and three in the fantasy playoffs.

durable.text: He is not a classic point guard or a perfect on-ball creator.
He blocks almost no shots, even for a guard, so punt BLK builds lose little with him.

note: Market prices are low: Yahoo value 9 USD and ESPN value 3 USD, with average costs under 2 USD and ranks of 86 to 90. That puts him near the end of our 144-player pool, below the 13 USD our league paid last season. He brings threes, assists and a solid FT% but drags FG% (about 43.5%) and gives no blocks, so he fits punt BLK guard builds best. Early in the season, check his three-point volume off the ball, whether his pull-up shooting recovers, and how much he runs the offense when Kawhi sits.
